name: Aevrin
description: Agent-neutral security skills from Aevrin Security for AI-assisted security analysis and development.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Source-first security audit workflow: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, adversarial validation, structured findings, and reports.

skills.name: agentic-actions-auditor
skills.description: Audits GitHub Actions workflows for security vulnerabilities in AI agent integrations (Claude Code Action, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, GitHub AI Inference)

skills.name: code-understanding
skills.description: Understand a codebase before looking for bugs in it. Reads it function by function, records what each one assumes and depends on, and saves the write-ups to files instead of filling up the conversation.

skills.name: burpsuite-project-parser
skills.description: Search and extract data from Burp Suite project files (.burp) for security analysis

skills.name: c-review
skills.description: Comprehensive C/C++ security code review, with coverage verified against a parse of the source

skills.name: differential-review
skills.description: Security-focused differential review of code changes with git history analysis and blast radius estimation

skills.name: dimensional-analysis
skills.description: Annotates codebases with dimensional analysis comments documenting units, dimensions, and decimal scaling. Use when someone asks to annotate units in a codebase, perform a dimensional analysis, or find vulnerabilities in a DeFi protocol. Prevents dimensional mismatches and catches formula bugs early.

skills.name: false-positive-check
skills.description: Systematic false positive verification for security bug analysis with mandatory gate reviews

skills.name: insecure-defaults
skills.description: Detects insecure default configurations including hardcoded credentials, fallback secrets, weak authentication defaults, and dangerous values in production

skills.name: rust-review
skills.description: Comprehensive Rust security code review with specialized bug-finding agents covering the safe/unsafe boundary, memory safety in unsafe blocks, concurrency, panic-induced DoS, recursion-induced stack overflow, FFI, and async runtime hazards

skills.name: semgrep-rule-creator
skills.description: Create custom Semgrep rules for detecting bug patterns and security vulnerabilities

skills.name: semgrep-rule-variant-creator
skills.description: Creates language variants of existing Semgrep rules with proper applicability analysis and test-driven validation

skills.name: risky-apis
skills.description: Identify error-prone APIs, dangerous configurations, and footgun designs that enable security mistakes

skills.name: static-analysis
skills.description: Static analysis toolkit with CodeQL, Semgrep, and SARIF parsing for security vulnerability detection

skills.name: supply-chain-risk-auditor
skills.description: Audit a project's npm, PyPI, and Go dependencies for supply-chain risk: version-matched advisories for direct dependencies and the full lockfile tree, abandoned upstreams, npm publisher concentration, and install scripts

skills.name: similar-bug-finder
skills.description: Find similar vulnerabilities and bugs across codebases using pattern-based analysis

skills.name: report-triage
skills.description: Principled framework for triaging vulnerability reports using 7 brocards (rules of thumb). Evaluates incoming CVEs, bug bounty submissions, and security findings against structured dismissal/acceptance criteria before escalating to deeper analysis.

skills.name: code-improver
skills.description: Improves code targets - skills, plugins, or a branch's changes - through an autonomous review-and-fix workflow with a pluggable reviewer (any installed skill or agent), a cross-round findings ledger, oscillation escalation, and a mechanical scope guard.

skills.name: devcontainer-setup
skills.description: Create pre-configured devcontainers with Claude Code and language-specific tooling

skills.name: gh-cli
skills.description: Intercepts GitHub URL fetches (WebFetch and MCP fetch tools) and curl/wget commands, redirecting to the authenticated gh CLI.

skills.name: git-cleanup
skills.description: Safely analyzes and cleans up local git branches and worktrees by categorizing them as merged, squash-merged, superseded, or active work.

skills.name: github-triage
skills.description: Triages a repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests via the gh CLI: optionally merges ready bot and maintainer-approved PRs and spawns review subagents for unreviewed ones, closes already-resolved issues with referenced explanations, cross-links issues with pending fix PRs, and assigns local-only priority and change-size estimates.

skills.name: goal-prompt
skills.description: Drafts copy-ready /goal commands for goal mode in Claude Code and Codex: verifiable completion conditions with stop bounds, normalized to a single line under the 4,000-character cap.

skills.name: random-pick
skills.description: Draws the 12 Houses of the Zodiac Tarot spread using cryptographic randomness to add 100+ bits of entropy to vague or underspecified planning. Interprets the spread to guide next steps. Use when feeling lucky, invoking heart-of-the-cards energy, or when prompts are ambiguous.

skills.name: modern-cpp
skills.description: Modern C++ best practices (C++20/23/26). Use when writing C++ code, creating new C++ projects, or modernizing legacy C++ patterns.

skills.name: modern-python
skills.description: Modern Python best practices. Use when creating new Python projects, and writing Python scripts, or migrating existing projects from legacy tools.

skills.name: open-sourcing
skills.description: Prepares a repository for public open-source release: secrets-history hygiene, license selection, documentation and CI readiness checks, and language-specific packaging and release guidance.

skills.name: review-walkthrough
skills.description: Generates an interactive HTML walkthrough for reviewing code changes. Use only when explicitly called.

skills.name: second-opinion
skills.description: Gets independent code reviews from Codex or Antigravity for uncommitted changes, branch diffs, and commits.

skills.name: yara-authoring
skills.description: YARA-X detection rule authoring with linting and quality analysis

skills.name: firebase-apk-scanner
skills.description: Scan Android APKs for Firebase security misconfigurations including open databases, storage buckets, authentication issues, and exposed cloud functions. For authorized security research only.

skills.name: dwarf-debug-info
skills.description: Analyze DWARF debug information: parse and search DIEs with dwarfdump and readelf, verify debug info integrity, and write DWARF parsing code

skills.name: building-secure-contracts
skills.description: Comprehensive smart contract security toolkit based on the Building Secure Contracts framework. Includes vulnerability scanners for 6 blockchains and 5 development guideline assistants.

skills.name: entry-point-analyzer
skills.description: Analyzes smart contract codebases to identify state-changing entry points for security auditing. Detects externally callable functions that modify state, categorizes them by access level, and generates structured audit reports.

skills.name: claude-in-chrome-troubleshooting
skills.description: Diagnose and fix Claude in Chrome MCP extension connectivity issues

skills.name: constant-time-analysis
skills.description: Detect compiler-induced timing side-channels in cryptographic code

skills.name: post-patch-validation
skills.description: Validates security patches against the reported bug, root-cause variants, and surrounding behavior. Returns reproducible failures to repair and validation gaps, with pinned inputs and saved evidence. Bundles a validate-patch dynamic workflow for Claude Code.

skills.name: property-based-testing
skills.description: Write, review, and triage property-based tests - Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, and Echidna or Medusa for Solidity invariants

skills.name: spec-to-code-compliance
skills.description: Check code against the documentation that specifies it: one agent per requirement, divergences refuted before they are reported, evidence cited to the line

skills.name: writing-lean-proofs
skills.description: Structured Lean 4 proof writing and library design following Mathlib conventions

skills.name: secret-wipe-audit
skills.description: Detects missing or compiler-optimized zeroization of sensitive data with assembly and control-flow analysis

skills.name: codegraph
skills.description: Builds source and binary code graphs for security analysis, context slicing, mutation testing, cryptographic protocol modeling, finding triage, and variant analysis.

skills.name: testing-skills
skills.description: Skills from the Aevrin Security Application Security Testing Guide (aevrin.net)

skills.name: team-profile
skills.description: Interprets Team Profile survey results for individuals and teams

skills.name: mutation-testing
skills.description: Configures mutator or mutator-sol campaigns, analyzes surviving mutants, and investigates bugs exposed by testing gaps. Use when setting up mutation testing, reviewing campaign results, identifying equivalent mutants, or finding bugs from surviving mutations.
